decisions.reason: The firm has already invested in the dumper and committed to it publicly, so escalation of commitment makes management likely to keep it while attributing weak results to temporary market conditions.
As a product line with several models and a dedicated website page, the firm has sunk substantial investment and public commitment into this lift, making a write-off hard to justify.
Because this building material lift is a multi-model line with visible public commitment, the management is inclined to persist and interpret disappointing results as temporary.
Although a single model, the truck-mounted lift builds on the firm's lifting expertise and was publicly launched, so the sunk costs and need for justification favor keeping it.
